sources.snippet: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects.

sources.title: Meet Microduck, a $399 Open-Source Robot That Can Learn New Tricks - PCMag
sources.snippet: The robot comes from AI model platform Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics arm. Preorders open today with shipments slated to arrive before Christmas.
